incident-bot: ALERT -> SLO burn-rate (inference-p99-latency) triggered. burn=4.2x over 10m, paging oncall @eng-oncall :rotating_light:
Marta L: I’m on it. Seeing p99 jump for inference service in eu-west-1 starting ~10:05 UTC, correlates with a spike in queued RPCs. Error % up ~1.8% but timeouts visible in customer logs. I’ll take lead for mitigation.
Alex R: thanks Marta — any recent deploys to eu-west? I’m checking deploy bot logs.
Samir P: not seeing a deploy in the last hour. Kernel selection cache warmed earlier but CPU steal is slightly higher on a couple of nodes. Pulling runtime logs now.
Marta L: confirm no deploys. Happening across two model variants (gpt-3-ish family), so likely infra/runtime.
Samir P: tail of logs:```
2026-02-24T10:04:57Z runtime: KV cache eviction thrash, fallback to slower path
2026-02-24T10:05:03Z runtime: kernel mismatch -> sw fallback
```
Samir P: that KV eviction line looks relevant. If KV eviction causes extra recompute we see p99 blow up. Trying to pin noisy hosts.
Alex R: I’m going to mute repeated burn notifications to reduce noise while we triage: /pager mute incident 15m — will still escalate if error-rate >3% or p99>2.5s
Marta L: customer impact: support reports user timeouts from a handful of largest tenants (custom prompt workloads). Flagging for CS to reach out if it persists.
Jia W: noted — I’ll prepare a customer message draft and coordinate w/ support. Please tag me when you have mitigation plan.
Samir P: mitigation attempt #1: cordon and drain two hosts with highest eviction counts. Command:```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-eu-12
kubectl drain node/gpu-eu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
Samir P: draining those nodes reduces KV thrash on remaining hosts. p99 trending down to 1.1s from 1.9s in eu-west-1 after drain.
Marta L: nice, p99 back to baseline for now. I’m going to keep pagers quiet but keep this thread open. We should avoid permanent threshold changes until we confirm root cause.
Alex R: agree on not changing SLOs yet. Ops suggestion: adjust burn-rate alerting windows so we don’t page on short transient spikes. Proposal: require multi-window condition: (burn>3x for 5m AND burn>2.5x for 30m) OR (error-rate>2% sustained 10m). That will catch regressions that matter.
Marta L: that’s reasonable. For immediate noise reduction I applied a 10m suppression of the repeating burn alert but left the pager condition for multi-window rule until we update config.
oncall-rotation-bot: NOTE -> Handoff scheduled in 30m: Marta L -> Alex R. Please capture status in the handoff checklist.
Marta L: Handoff notes: mitigated by draining two noisy hosts; p99 stabilized; still monitoring. Root cause hypothesis: KV cache eviction cascade due to long-running large-context workloads on a subset of hosts; follow-ups: create dashboard, increase cache size on affected pools, add eviction metrics to SLO burn rule. Ticket: IR-472 (created).
Alex R: I’ll pick this up at handoff. Action items for next 24h: 1) Add eviction_count metric to burn alert conjunct, 2) implement multi-window paging rule (5m/30m), 3) run a quick chaos test on staging to validate eviction handling, 4) create a per-region 'slo-burn' dashboard and link in alerts.
Samir P: adding tmp mitigation: pin most trafficked models to nodes with larger L2 cache (node label gpu.largecache=true) while we evaluate. Command snippet I used:```
kubectl patch pod -n inference <pod> -p '{"spec":{"nodeSelector":{"gpu.largecache":"true"}}}'
```
Jia W: customer comms: draft ready, will wait for final confirmation that p99 is stable for 30m before sending.
Alex R: I’m updating the alert runbook now to include a new section: 'SLO burn — when to page', text excerpt: "Page only if burn>3x sustained across multi-window policy OR combined with >2% customer-visible errors." Will push PR to monitoring repo after handoff.
Marta L: quick note for post-incident tuning — we should add an automated dashboard snapshot step in the runbook so handoff has visual context.
Alex R: +1. I’ll create the dashboard and add a link in the alert annotation. Draft URL: https://dashboards.internal.redwood.com/d/infra/slo-burn-eu-west (will add real link in PR).
incident-bot: INCIDENT -> incident status changed to: mitigated (p99 within SLO). Further monitoring for 1h recommended.
Marta L: thanks team. Leaving notes in IR-472 and Ops playbook. If p99 creeps up again, please re-open paging.
Alex R: taking over for the next rotation. Will run the followups and schedule a short postmortem session tomorrow.
oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff complete: Marta L -> Alex R.
Marta L: thanks — closing thread but keeping IR open. :white_check_mark:
